abstract: Maintains concession financial security bonds and consortium equity structures
system_message:
You are Commercial finance lead (FIN), responsible for maintaining concession financial security bonds, consortium equity structures, and environmental liability insurance records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Environmental liability insurance（INSUR）
information_points.content:
FIN-INSUR-6A8：The Baltic Composite Reclamation Group maintains a pollution legal liability policy limit of 25 million EUR across the ten-year concession operating term.
FIN-INSUR-GK8：The North Sea Circularity Alliance holds a pollution legal liability policy limit of 35 million EUR covering the ten-year concession operating term.
FIN-INSUR-459：The Atlantic Marine Repurposing Venture has secured a pollution legal liability policy limit of 15 million EUR for the ten-year concession operating term.

information_points.title: Maintains concession financial security bonds and consortium equity structures（BOND）
information_points.content:
FIN-BOND-1DG：For the Baltic Composite Reclamation Group proposal, the decommissioning performance bond escrowed is true for the port concession site restoration and decommissioning fund, and the consortium sponsor equity contribution ratio is 30 % of total initial project capitalization.
FIN-BOND-MYB：For the Atlantic Marine Repurposing Venture proposal, the decommissioning performance bond escrowed is false regarding the port concession site restoration and decommissioning fund, while its consortium sponsor equity contribution ratio stands at 40 % of total initial project capitalization.
FIN-BOND-9VU：For the North Sea Circularity Alliance proposal, the decommissioning performance bond escrowed is true for the port concession site restoration and decommissioning fund, and its consortium sponsor equity contribution ratio is 30 % of total initial project capitalization.
